name: hom-6-document-viewport

environment.viewport: 1440x900 logical, DPR 1, text scale 1, cache extent 250

decision: The immutable pre-HOM-6 control remains in baseline.json for historical comparison.

The document viewport's 8.4 ms cold-mount p95 replaces the 5.0 ms control comparison because it includes natural-height measurement, document semantics, selection coordination, and the accessible reorder gutter while remaining below the 16 ms stretch target.
The accepted viewport improves steady-state scroll p95 from 12.9 ms to 8.4 ms and eliminates repeated engine layouts after one outward warm-up traversal.
